title: Is Translation All You Need? A Study on Solving Multilingual Tasks with Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing model performance across 24 diverse languages on multiple NLP benchmarks (e.g., MGSM, XCOPA, XNLI) and real user queries, specifically testing whether translating prompts into English yields better results than prompting in the native language due to English-centric training.

Assessing model accuracy on culture-related tasks (e.g., M3Exam) and real-world user queries that require local cultural knowledge, measuring how translation to English impacts the model's ability to capture cultural nuances compared to native language processing.
